one_line: Early 15th-century Sultan of Malwa who turned Mandu into the joy-filled courtly city of Shadiabad while fighting frontier campaigns from Gujarat to Gondwana.

appearance.age_look: mid-40s, medium height, solid but not bulky build
appearance.face: oval face with high cheekbones, wheatish-brown complexion, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, straight nose, sharp dark eyes with a calm commanding gaze, default expression composed and observant with a faint, confident half-smile
appearance.hair: black hair, kept short and mostly hidden under a soft, slightly tall, white cotton turban wrapped in simple layers with a narrow dark-green band near the base and no extravagant ornament
appearance.costume: deep-green silk jama (Mughal-style wrap coat) reaching mid-calf with long fitted sleeves, front overlap tied at the right with a hidden tie, subtle gold-toned floral butti motifs woven sparsely across the fabric, worn over a cream cotton angarkha-style inner tunic visible at the collar and sleeve edges; loose cream cotton churidar-style trousers with gentle folds at the ankles; broad dark-brown leather kamarband belt around the waist with a simple metal buckle; dark-brown leather mojari shoes with modest upturned toes and minimal stitching; a light off-white cotton shawl with a fine green border draped from the left shoulder around the back, the end hanging to thigh level; minimal jewellery: a single plain gold signet ring on his right hand and small gold studs at his ears, avoiding heavy royal regalia to suggest a campaigning ruler
appearance.signature: a slightly curved talwar with a plain steel blade, a dark-bronze disc-shaped pommel and crossguard, carried sheathed at his left hip in a dark-brown leather scabbard with simple brass fittings, his right hand often resting lightly on the hilt

ref_desc: Hoshang Shah appears as a mid-40s wheatish-brown oval-faced ruler with short beard, white turban, deep-green patterned silk jama, cream churidar trousers, off-white shawl, dark-brown belt and shoes, and a sheathed curved talwar with dark-bronze hilt and brown scabbard in a green-cream-brown-gold palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Hoshang Shah: a mid-40s, medium-build, wheatish-brown ruler with an oval face, sharp dark eyes, straight nose, and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, wearing a simple soft white cotton turban with a narrow dark-green band. Show him in a deep-green silk jama reaching mid-calf, with long fitted sleeves, right-side overlap, and subtle gold floral butti motifs, over a cream cotton inner tunic visible at the collar and cuffs. His loose cream churidar trousers gather in gentle folds at the ankles, tucked into dark-brown leather mojari shoes with modest upturned toes. A broad dark-brown leather belt circles his waist, and a light off-white cotton shawl with a fine green border is draped from his left shoulder across his back, the end hanging to his thigh. Include a single plain gold ring on his right hand and small gold ear studs. At his left hip, show his signature slightly curved talwar, sheathed in a dark-brown leather scabbard with simple brass fittings, the dark-bronze disc pommel and crossguard visible at the hilt, with his right hand resting lightly on it. Keep the colours deep green, cream, off-white, dark brown, and gold, and present him front-facing in a composed, dignified stance suitable for reuse in many panels.
